MODELS
Two models to choose from.
You can’t go wrong when you choose Trax as your traveling companion.
LS LT
Trax LS is the small SUV that fits into tight spaces and just about any budget. Take a step up in style, convenience and comfort in Trax LT.
• 1.4L Turbo engine and 6-speed • 6-speaker audio system • Roof-mounted luggage rack side rails • Cruise control
automatic transmission • Two USB ports2 • Remote vehicle starter system • Deluxe Cloth/leatherette
• Power-adjustable outside rearview • Rear Vision Camera3 • Projector-style halogen headlamps seating surfaces
mirrors • Remote Keyless Entry • LED taillamps
• 16-inch aluminum wheels • S iriusXM®4 3-month trial subscription • Heated power-adjustable outside Midnight Edition available
• Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system1 rearview mirrors Redline Edition available
with 7-inch diagonal color touch-screen • Front and rear fascia skid plates Sport Edition available
• Deep-tinted rear windows and
liftgate glass
